proof_policy: Prefer a native Alex's Mobs material when it is deterministic enough and actually tells the story.
Do not require stack-sized rare drops or turn a premium expedition into RNG farming.
Use objective-state or custom proof items when the native drop is unsuitable, random, or would incentivize killing a creature the story intends to protect.
Items with progression-sensitive behavior such as Elytra-equivalent flight stay gated until the broader pack progression allows them.
